# `unix_timestamp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the UNIX timestamp of current or specified time.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
unix_timestamp([timeExp[, fmt]])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- unix_timestamp, example 1
> SELECT unix_timestamp();
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- unix_timestamp, example 2
> SELECT unix_timestamp('2016-04-08', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
-- the result differs on every run
```

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
